universe.rule: Do not pass only three assets and claim to validate cross-sectional low-vol selection; freeze a broader point-in-time eligible universe or explicitly register a separate three-asset trend-only control.

signal.rank: ascending population standard deviation of latest 30 log returns

proposedSchedule.selection: Saturday 00:00 UTC after required closed observations have been received
proposedSchedule.execution: next executable quote after all required signal inputs are available

knownLimitations: H7 is a signal selector, not a running paper account or portfolio engine
Prototype requiresTradePlan flag and legacy CRV documents need versioned migration; do not reinterpret as an execution gate pass
25 percent weights do not establish equal risk; crypto correlations and gap losses require portfolio controls
Trial registration must count existing H7 design and preserve failures; no new budget reset
